objective.text: Recheck mutable authorization at execution time for a deferred privileged operation.

difficulty.rationale: Enforce the stated execution-time permission contract rather than trusting an earlier decision indefinitely.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An export can expose private records. Policy requires the requester to still be authorized when it executes, and access may be revoked after dispatch. Which design enforces that policy?

options.text: Check only that the resource still exists before exporting it.
options.rationale: Existence does not establish the requester’s current permission to read it.
options.misconception: Existence does not establish the requester’s current permission to read it.

options.text: Use a signed queue name so the worker treats every submitted export as permanently authorized.
options.rationale: Transport routing or integrity does not replace the application’s execution-time access policy.
options.misconception: Transport routing or integrity does not replace the application’s execution-time access policy.

options.text: Store the requester and resource IDs, reload them, and authorize again before reading private data.
options.rationale: A queued approval is not current permission; the handler must evaluate the live policy under the stated requirement.

options.text: Serialize the controller’s earlier true authorization result and rely on it in handle.
options.rationale: That freezes an obsolete decision and ignores revocation before execution.
options.misconception: That freezes an obsolete decision and ignores revocation before execution.
